viewport-organization.copy: Viewport organization keeps the atomic control predictable: one fixed circle, one readable label, and optional support text that wraps without pushing the control out of alignment.

items.title: Touch rows
items.rule: Use comfortable row height and wrap support text under the label.

demo.label: Fastest route
demo.description: Prioritize arrival time for active deliveries.

items.title: Configuration lists
items.rule: Use medium density for desktop settings and inspector panels.

items.title: Dense tables
items.rule: Use compact density only when the parent pattern keeps the question and context visible.
